test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: QIWC is related to OGTZ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GONY is related to EMKV. To which of the given options is FPJA related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic is based on a consistent shift backward in the English alphabetical order. The first two letters are shifted by **-2**, and the last two letters are shifted by **-3**.

Analysis of the given pairs:

**For ‘QIWC’ to ‘OGTZ’:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0298aad3153ec4e9876ee4bde2ad6b481b25865c4551475a6294011353ba0786.png] 

**For ‘GONY’ to ‘EMKV’:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca80faf520e22dc733926a49e3cf3136fd12ea7dab0639c95c1d939704829589.png] 

Applying the logic to ‘FPJA’:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59053189cfd3afdf596a348bdd7fe7ec7e7df792e57a2d575c5ca3016e86f544.png] 

By applying the same logic, ‘FPJA’ is coded as **DNGX**.

This corresponds to **Option 3**.
